name: 野生动物花园 2
description: 再来十六位大花丛中的野生朋友：小熊、熊猫、考拉、袋鼠、骆驼、鳄鱼、树懒、狐猴、孔雀、小熊猫、树蛙、霍加狓、犰狳、蝴蝶、耳廓狐和疣猪。
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no fur, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly wild animal, centered, in a simple garden with big flowers and leaves. About 16 large closed areas to color. Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Nothing scary, no teeth, no claws. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.
